results=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='readonly-package-review-') as td:
 tmp=Path(td).resolve();root=tmp/'source';root.mkdir()
 target='ops/example.py';source=root/target;source.parent.mkdir()
 source.write_bytes(b'x = 1')
 untouched=root/'preserved.txt';untouched.write_bytes(b'preserved\n')
 baseline=v.source_snapshot(root)
 patch=tmp/'change.patch';patch.write_text(b.source_patch(b'x = 1',b'x = 2\n',target))
 v.patch_scope(root,patch,target);v.run_patch(root,patch,check=True);v.run_patch(root,patch)

  else:raise AssertionError(case+' was accepted')
